meta.name: caveman-compress
meta.description: Compress natural language memory files (CLAUDE.md, todos, preferences) into caveman format to save input tokens. Preserves all technical substance, code, URLs, and structure. Compressed version overwrites the original file. Human-readable backup saved as FILE.original.md. Trigger: /caveman-compress FILEPATH or "compress memory file"

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把记忆文件压成精简格式,节省输入开销
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果用 AI 工具时觉得上下文太占空间、又想保留关键信息
copy.tagline_en: Compress memory files into a terse format to cut input costs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI tools and want smaller context without losing key details

howto.what: 收到压缩请求后,Claude 会运行脚本,把 CLAUDE.md、待办、偏好等自然语言记忆文件压成很短的“穴居人风格”句子,减少占用的输入量。代码、链接、标题等原样保留;压缩结果覆盖原文件,并在系统数据目录另存一份可读备份。
howto.when: 当你说“压缩记忆文件”,或输入 /caveman-compress 加文件路径时触发。

say.text: 把 CLAUDE.md 压缩成穴居人风格
say.note: 压缩后覆盖原文件,并另存备份。
按默认流程自动检测并压缩。

howto.what_en: On request, Claude compresses memory files (CLAUDE.md, todos, preferences) into caveman-style short text to save tokens. Code, URLs, headings, tables stay intact. Compressed version overwrites original; readable backup saved to data dir.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says "compress memory file" or enters /caveman-compress with a filepath.

say_en.note: Compresses and overwrites the original, with a backup saved.
